PROGRAM zcv_long_names.

* Module data and FORM locals live across a suspension become members named
* mv_ggconv_<name>, which must stay within 30 characters and unique.
MODULE build INPUT.
  DATA lt_fieldcatalog_shiptype TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH DEFAULT KEY.
  DATA lt_fieldcatalog_shiptypf TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.
  DATA lt_fieldcatalog_ship TYPE c LENGTH 4.
  APPEND `A` TO lt_fieldcatalog_shiptype.
  APPEND 1 TO lt_fieldcatalog_shiptypf.
  lt_fieldcatalog_ship = 'SHIP'.
ENDMODULE.

FORM ask.
  DATA lv_answer_from_the_long_popup TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      text_question = 'Go?'
    IMPORTING
      answer        = lv_answer_from_the_long_popup.
  IF lv_answer_from_the_long_popup = '1'.
    MESSAGE 'yes' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

MODULE ask INPUT.
  PERFORM ask.
ENDMODULE.
